say:3:1510462001:0.text: That was <style="highlight">Sarethiel's sigil</style>, wasn't it, Perseus?

say:4:1510462002:0.text: Are you saying that all of this... the floods, the swarms, the dead... are all due to Sarethiel's wrath?!
say:4:1510462002:0.source_cn: 你是要说这一切——洪水、虫灾、船橹一样漂浮在水面上的尸...

say:5:1510462003:0.text: We've always honored him, loved him! What crime have we committed?!
say:5:1510462003:0.source_cn: 我们像往常一样敬奉他、爱戴他！呼临何罪之有？！

say:6:1510462004:0.text: Look at this city... Look what it's become...
say:6:1510462004:0.source_cn: 看看这座城……我试图拯救她，可她现在变成了什么模样？！

say:15:1510464001:0.text: Look at them! Trapped in the flood, fighting for their lives! Can't you see them slipping away?!
say:15:1510464001:0.source_cn: 看看那些在洪水中挣扎的人，看看那些逐渐消逝的生命！

say:16:1510464002:0.text: I even talked them into trusting you! I swore that after your damn spell, they'd never starve or suffer drought again!
say:16:1510464002:0.source_cn: 我甚至亲自说服了其中一些人，让他们信任你们！让他们相信...

say:17:1510464003:0.text: I thought I was saving Halia... Instead, I led the enemy right through our gates...
say:17:1510464003:0.source_cn: 我以为自己正在拯救呼临城，其实是在引敌入室……

say:18:1510464004:0.text: Perseus, grief and pain are tearing you apart... Maybe my words won't reach you.
say:18:1510464004:0.source_cn: 珀尔修斯，悲恸和痛苦正在蚕食你敏锐的心灵……这些话，或...

say:19:1510464005:0.text: Yet, this was never the Arcane Council's design. We've tested this over and over. The magic circle we activated only summons a little rain, just enough to ease the drought and revive the land.
say:19:1510464005:0.source_cn: 但是，这一切并非魔法师协会的意愿。我们反复实验过，发动...

say:20:1510464006:0.text: None of this was caused by our magic.
say:20:1510464006:0.source_cn: 当前发生的一切，都不是魔法所致。

say:21:1510464007:0.text: You spoke the truth before. You saw Sarethiel's sigil flash before your eyes. But even now, you can't bring yourself to believe it...
say:21:1510464007:0.source_cn: 你之前已经说出真相，丰饶神的图腾就在你面前闪烁，但是你...

say:22:1510464008:0.text: How could I believe it? That our beloved god would suddenly curse and punish us...
say:22:1510464008:0.source_cn: ……怎么相信？相信我们敬爱的丰饶神会突然降罪吗？

say:24:1510464009:0.text: My people did nothing wrong. The fault lies with me alone.
say:24:1510464009:0.source_cn: 呼临人毫无过错。错在我。

say:25:1510464010:0.text: Lygos was right. I was so pathetic to trust my enemies.
say:25:1510464010:0.source_cn: 隆尔说得对。我，如此可悲，竟然轻信了自己的敌人。

choice_prompt:26:1510464010.text: Lygos was right. I was so pathetic to trust my enemies.
choice_prompt:26:1510464010.source_cn: 隆尔说得对。我，如此可悲，竟然轻信了自己的敌人。

narration:27:1510464011:1.text: A glint of silver cuts through the air as Perseus drives his spear toward you, swift and merciless.
narration:27:1510464011:1.source_cn: 一道闪光从眼前划过，珀尔修斯向你刺出了长枪！

say:28:1510464012:1.text: At last, your mask falls away, Hunting God! You've taken everything from me!
say:28:1510464012:1.source_cn: 狩猎神，你夺走了我的一切！
say:28:1510464012:1.male: At last, your mask falls away, Hunting God! You've taken everything from me!
say:28:1510464012:1.female: At last, your mask falls away, Hunting Goddess! You've taken everything from me!

say:29:1510464013:0.text: Gorgonna... She died for you! And now the same monster who forced her to sacrifice herself is slaughtering the city I love!
say:29:1510464013:0.source_cn: 露……她为你而死！而让她被迫献出生命的凶手，现在又在屠...
say:29:1510464013:0.male: Gorgonna... She died for you! And now the same monster who forced her to sacrifice herself is slaughtering the city I love!
say:29:1510464013:0.female: Gorgonna... She died for you! And now the same monster who forced her to sacrifice herself is slaughtering the city I love!

say:30:1510464014:0.text: Our pain, our lives! Are they nothing but toys for your amusement?!
say:30:1510464014:0.source_cn: 狩猎神，在你眼里，我们凡人的生命和苦痛，是可以用来玩弄...
say:30:1510464014:0.male: Our pain, our lives! Are they nothing but toys for your amusement?!
say:30:1510464014:0.female: Our pain, our lives! Are they nothing but toys for your amusement?!

say:35:1510464017:0.text: This is the last time. No more masks, no more lies! I see you for what you are!
say:35:1510464017:0.source_cn: 这是最后一次。你再也不能用虚伪的面容和谎言欺骗我了，狩猎神。
say:35:1510464017:0.male: This is the last time. No more masks, no more lies! I see you for what you are!
say:35:1510464017:0.female: This is the last time. No more masks, no more lies! I see you for what you are!

say:36:1510464018:0.text: I finally understand why Sarethiel gave me this spear and shield. It was for this day...
say:36:1510464018:0.source_cn: 我终于明白，丰饶神正是为了今天，才将枪与盾赐予我……

say:39:1510464019:0.text: Wait, Perseus! What are you doing?!
say:39:1510464019:0.source_cn: 等等，珀尔修斯，你要做什么？！

narration:46:1510464023:0.text: The divine spear, brimming with Sarethiel's power, thrusts forward once more.
narration:46:1510464023:0.source_cn: 蕴含丰饶神神力的长枪再次刺来

narration:47:1510464024:0.text: Merlin lifts her staff. A burst of golden magic surges, wrapping around you in a radiant embrace.

narration:48:1510464025:0.source_cn: 呼临城，还有珀尔修斯愤怒的面容

narration:49:1510464026:0.text: ...along with the rage twisting Perseus' face...
narration:49:1510464026:0.source_cn: 迅速在你们面前消失了……

choice:34:0:1.text: I don't know who Gorgonna is.
choice:34:0:1.male: I don't know who Gorgonna is.
choice:34:0:1.female: I don't know who Gorgonna is.

choice:34:1:2.male: Forget it, you can't beat me.
choice:34:1:2.female: Forget it, you can't beat me.
